name: National Data & Security
summary: Parent company of the useoz budget dialup ISP (National Data & Security Pty Ltd); went into administration 2 Oct 2002 (per ASIC); ABN cancelled 2012.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of nds.com.au Jan 1999. CAUTION: nds.com.au 1999 capture shows 'Neo Design Synergy' — different company; do not use nds.com.au captures as evidence for this ISP.
